data_status.stop_coordinates: public map coordinates, hand-checked against OpenStreetMap
data_status.route_geometry: OpenStreetMap road routing (OSRM), see each route's source field
data_status.stop_capacities: planner-supplied comfort thresholds for a bus shelter, NOT official RTL figures
data_status.stop_descriptions: context only; not used in any computation
data_status.fleet: assumed vehicle classes and capacities; NOT official RTL fleet data
data_status.demand: no RTL demand data is available to this project - all passenger volumes are measured from public reference footage or clearly labelled simulation

routes.name: Route 2: Carnival Terminal ↔ Hulhumalé Phase 1 Central
Route 3: Malé / Hulhumalé ↔ Velana International Airport
routes.source: OpenStreetMap routing (OSRM); stop order corrected to Malé -> Hulhumalé -> Airport
routes.modelling_note: This ordering backtracks across the Sinamale Bridge twice (Malé -> Hulhumalé -> Airport). It is the geometrically valid road route for these three stops, but a real airport express would terminate at the airport, not continue to Hulhumalé.
